definitions.explanation: The last day of the typical work week. The kanji 金 means 'gold/metal' and relates to Venus (the 'metal planet' in East Asian tradition).

examples.japanese: {金曜日|きんようび}の{夜|よる}は{飲|の}みに{行|い}きます。
examples.english: On Friday night, I go out drinking.

examples.japanese: {金曜日|きんようび}が{楽|たの}しみです。
{金曜日|きんようび}は{早|はや}く{帰|かえ}ります。
examples.english: I go home early on Friday.

notes: Friday uses 金 (gold/metal), corresponding to the planet Venus. In Japanese work culture, Friday evening ('kin'youbi no yoru') is often associated with after-work socializing. Can be abbreviated to 金曜 (kin'you).
